notes: GeoTalk 1.28: Profile tab এখন পুরোপুরি নতুন Settings — আগের সবকিছু হুবহু আগের মতোই আছে, শুধু Settings সাজানো হয়েছে বড় অ্যাপগুলোর মতো করে, আর প্রতিটি অপশন সত্যিই কাজ করে। Profile-এ এখন search, share আর edit বাটন আছে, আর নিচে পরপর: Linked devices (এই ফোনের তথ্য), Account (নাম, ছবি, About লাইন, GT-ID কপি, account delete), Privacy (ছবি/About কে দেখতে পারবে, blocked list, অচেনা নম্বরের কল auto-decline, disappearing messages timer), Lists (Favorites ও নিজের list — Chats tab-এ filter chip হয়ে আসে), Chats (font size, সব chat-এর backup JSON file, clear all chats, chat archive, Enter দিয়ে send), Appearance (default chat theme), Broadcasts (একসাথে অনেকজনকে message), Notifications (message tone, vibrate, high priority, ringtone — সব আলাদা করে), Storage and data (network usage-সহ), Accessibility (বেশি contrast, animation বন্ধ), Help, Invite, App updates। Chat, voice call, Bluetooth/WiFi, Random — সব আগের মতোই চলবে, আর পুরনো version (1.10–1.27) এর সাথে আগের মতোই chat ও কল করা যাবে। GeoTalk 1.28: the Profile tab is now a complete Settings section — everything else works exactly as before; only Settings has been rebuilt in the style of the big apps, and every option really works. The Profile header gains search, share and edit buttons, followed by: Linked devices (this phone's details), Account (name, photo, About line, tap-to-copy GT-ID, delete account), Privacy (who can see your photo/About, blocked list, auto-decline calls from unknown numbers, disappearing-messages timer), Lists (Favorites and your own lists — they become filter chips on the Chats tab), Chats (font size, back up all chats to one JSON file, clear all chats, chat archiving, Enter key sends), Appearance (default chat theme), Broadcasts (message many contacts at once), Notifications (message tone, vibrate and high priority, separate from call ringtone and vibrate), Storage and data (including real network usage), Accessibility (higher contrast, animations off), Help, Invite a friend and App updates. Chat, voice calls, Bluetooth/WiFi and Random work exactly as before, and chats and calls with older versions (1.10–1.27) work as before.
